Document the verbatim source S: horizontal proportion, constant stroke, selective returns, square terminals. Isolated use is a study; final symbol decision remains open. Superseded by the user-selected thin circle S from the original document.

User approved Caveat from Born Curious and Still Human, rejected the other apparel fonts and the SUPER INTELLIGENCE / SINAPSE micro tagline. Current tees must be regular fit; new Bricolage Grotesque and Space Mono trials; exact horizontal SNPS SI signature only. New fonts and mockups remain proposals.

Caio rejected the graphic between idea and action again. Removed from current PDF, reader and House poster. Horizontal descriptors now have one-cap-height gap. Keep existing thin S in a circle from Idv_SNPS.pdf page 8. Visual edition 07 replaces text-heavy presentation; 40 pages. Every apparel piece shows front and back: front simple circle mark, back phrase and SNPS SI. Regular tees and approved Caveat retained. Source PDF is raster-only; contour recovered, not native Bezier. Browser inspection remains pending due URL policy / user-reported connection refusal.

R originates in upper edge of bowl beam; other glyphs preserved. Existing S circular remains and exact inner contour is also available standalone. All 12 garments have both versions, front/back, with back SVGs preserved. Edition 08: 53 visual pages; 9 posts with 3 five-frame carousels; 5 four-frame highlights and 2 avatars.
